title.zh: 在西内格罗斯省La Carlota市镇La Granja村设立菲律宾大学农学院分院并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act to Establish in the Barrio of La Granja, Municipality of La Carlota, Province of Negros Occidental, a Branch of the College of Agriculture of the University of the Philippines, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2415_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby established in the barrio of La Granja, Municipality of La Carlota, Province of Negros Occidental, a branch of the College of Agriculture of the University of the Philippines, which shall offer courses as may be determined by the said college of agriculture.

The personnel of the branch shall be appointed as members of the staff of the College of Agriculture of the University of the Philippines, on detail in the said branch: Provided, That the personnel shall draw their salaries directly from the budget of the branch.
There is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of the funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sum of one million pesos to carry out the provisions of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon the date the funds authorized herein to be appropriated are provided for.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
